title: No safety on blade
text: No safety on blade. I think it’s pathetic and very unsafe to not include a blade cover of some sort. I mean how much would it cost to add a rubber piece that would enclose the tip of sharp blade. This alone makes this company questionable.

product_metadata.title: Spring Chef - Bench Scraper, Stainless Steel Dough Scraper, Pastry Scraper, Pizza and Dough Cutter, With Bonus Bowl Scraper, Black
features: Multifunctional Kitchen Scraper - This versatile bench scraper does more than just scrape dough. You can also use it for chopping fruits and vegetables, scooping chopped veggies or herbs, smoothing frosting on cake, and more.

Durable and Versatile Kitchen Tool - This scraper kitchen tool from Spring Chef can do nearly everything a knife can. With this scraper, you can switch from scraping to cutting and vice versa, without hassle.

Cuts and Scrapes Easily - With this dough cutter and scraper’s sharp stainless steel blade, slicing chilled pastry dough, pies, cakes, and other pastries is a breeze. This kitchen gadget also comes with a bowl scraper, which is great for curved surfaces and containers.

Built to Last - An excellent addition to your kitchen essentials, our easy to use, stainless steel bench scraper stands out due to its superior quality. So, you can look forward to using it repeatedly and conveniently in the long run.

Time-Saving and Handy - With this baking scraper, cutting dough has never been easier. The handy measurement markings provide added convenience, particularly for cutting pastries or dough in equal sizes.
